findings.failing_input: FROZEN_USD_TO_CAD = 1.36 is documented as 'Last reviewed 2026-Q2'. The current date is 2026-05-24, which is in Q2 2026 — the review is current. But the rate drifts over quarters; if not reviewed when 2026-Q3 starts (Jul-Sep), suggestions become misleading.
findings.expected: A reminder mechanism (e.g. a release-checklist item or env-var override) to bump quarterly.
findings.actual: Just a comment; relies on human discipline.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a code comment block or pre-commit reminder. Alternatively, allow env-var override: process.env.USD_TO_CAD_OVERRIDE.

uncertainty_notes: Single constant module with thorough rationale. Production P&L uses LIVE FX rate via getFxRate — only suggestion/preview math uses this frozen rate, so a slightly stale value here doesn't corrupt revenue numbers.
